title: Counterattack in Desperation
next_chapter_hook: Just as everyone held their breath, the azure light from the Tianji Record Fragment quietly faded, as if it had never glowed at all—yet deep within Chen Ji's eyes, there appeared a dark gleam that no one could decipher.

text.content: The azure light, like gossamer threads, wound around the Turtle Shell Fragment, swallowing all the mockery around it. The crowd fell silent, countless gazes fell upon Chen Ji's chest with bewildered suspicion—in the arms of this waste trampled underfoot, such a strange phenomenon was hidden? The leading middle-aged man from the Liu Family's expression suddenly changed. This was an Liu Family Elder dressed in brocade robes with a Jade Pendant at his waist. At this moment, he narrowed his eyes, forcibly suppressing the unease in his heart, and coldly said: 'Insignificant trickery! A single broken turtle shell dares to play tricks here?'

Chen Ji slowly straightened his body, his movements unhurried, as if the pressure and humiliation around him were merely an boring wind. He brushed the dust from his robe's corner. When he raised his eyes, they had become an abyss of calm. Upon seeing this, the Liu Family crowd felt an inexplicable chill in their hearts. This waste... why does he seem like a completely different person from before? There was no anger in that gaze, no humiliation, only a composure that made one's spine crawl.

dialogue.content: "The Liu Family Elder speaks wisely." Chen Ji slightly bowed, his posture respectfully flawless, yet a faint smile lingered at the corner of his mouth. "However, the junior ventures to ask the Elder a question— was the marriage contract my Chen Family and Liu Family established back then for Miss Liu Ruyan, or for some branch female of the Liu Family?"

text.content: At these words, the Liu Family Elder's expression stiffened slightly. Murmurs rippled through the crowd, and several senior cultivators frowned, as if remembering something. Upon seeing this, Chen Ji continued unhurriedly: "According to the junior's knowledge, what the Liu Family's old patriarch personally promised was a marriage contract with the Liu Family's legitimate eldest daughter. Yet Miss Liu Ruyan... seems to be merely a concubine's daughter from the Liu Family's third branch?" His voice was not loud, yet every word was clear, like needles piercing the Liu Family crowd's weak points.

dialogue.content: "Although the junior is a waste, I have no desire to climb up the social ladder." Chen Ji lightly flicked his sleeves. "Only, regarding the qualification for this marriage contract, I wonder if Elder Liu would kindly verify it in front of all the seniors present? If Miss Liu Ruyan is indeed the legitimate eldest daughter, the junior will accept any punishment today without complaint. But if she is not..."

text.content: Before he could finish, the Liu Family Elder's face had already shifted from pale to ashen. This marriage contract had been nothing more than an unguarded remark by the Liu Family's old patriarch in his cups. All these years, everyone in the Liu Family knew this clearly and never truly intended to honor it. Now, being publicly exposed by a waste, he was at a loss for how to respond. If he admitted it, the contract would become a joke; if he denied it, he would be slapping his own old patriarch's face—either path was a dead end.

dialogue.content: "Of course, the Elder manages countless affairs daily and may not recall these details." Chen Ji's tone shifted, his posture becoming even more humble. "The junior dares to speak out today merely to ask the Liu Family for a clear answer. If the Liu Family truly wishes to dissolve the engagement, the junior has no objections; but if you wish to bully the weak and trample upon..." He raised his eyes, his gaze calm as an ancient well. "Although the junior is weak, I too wish to know whether the rules of the Tianqing Sect still hold any meaning."

text.content: Silence fell over the surroundings. Beads of sweat gathered on the Liu Family Elder's forehead. He never expected that this waste, trampled by the entire sect, would possess such depth of cunning—一句话便将柳家拖入两难之地。In the back of the crowd, Liu Ruyan's mother, who had been watching coldly, suddenly turned pale as paper. She tightly gripped her maid's sleeve, her knuckles white from force, fear flickering in her eyes. This waste... how could he possibly know these things?

Chen Ji took all of this in, his smile deepening at the corners of his mouth. This was precisely the effect he wanted—not to expose or make a move, just a light touch, letting the other side contemplate it themselves. He knew that what the Liu Family feared most right now was not his counterattack, but not knowing how many trump cards he still held. This fear of the unknown was far more terrifying than swords and blades.

choice.prompt: The tide had turned; the Liu Family was caught between a rock and a hard place. Now Chen Ji faced a choice—press forward aggressively and tear apart all pretense, or stop at a good point and leave some room for maneuvering?

choices.description: Continue applying pressure, force the Liu Family to take a public stance, and definitively characterize today's incident as the Liu Family being in the wrong. The risk is that it might provoke the other side into desperate measures.
choices.visible_cost: Permanently become enemies with the Liu Family, losing all room for negotiation
choices.visible_reward: Gain public fame, letting everyone see the Liu Family's true colors
choices.risk_hint: The Liu Family may have hidden moves; the situation could spiral out of control

dialogue.content: "Since the Elder refuses to answer, the junior will speak for the Elder—this marriage contract was merely an drunken jest by the Liu Family's old patriarch, not to be taken seriously." Chen Ji's voice suddenly rose. "Everyone present witnessed today's events. The Liu Family bullied the weak with their power and fabricated lies. Although I, Chen Ji, am a waste, I cannot allow myself to be trampled upon!"

choices.description: Stop at the perfect moment, step back appropriately, showing both grace and giving the Liu Family a way out, secretly laying the groundwork for future exploitation.
choices.visible_cost: Failed to completely lift one's spirits; some observers may think he's still backing down
choices.visible_reward: The Liu Family owes him a favor, which can be used as a bargaining chip later; exit safely without drawing fire
choices.risk_hint: The Liu Family may think him weak and cause trouble again in the future

dialogue.content: "Forget it." Chen Ji sighed lightly, and an air of dejection actually appeared in his expression. "The junior misspoke today, causing trouble for the Elder. Regarding the marriage contract, let us discuss it again later; the junior does not dare to aspire above his station." After speaking, he clasped his hands in a bow, his posture reaching the pinnacle of humility—yet beneath those lowered eyelids, his gaze was cold as the polar star.

text.content: Just as the atmosphere僵持到极点, a hoarse yet authoritative voice suddenly came from the back of the crowd: "Enough." Everyone turned back to see an elderly man in gray robes arriving through the air, his aura restrained yet naturally exuding an intimidating pressure that made people dare not meet his gaze directly. Mo Xiansheng—that eccentric old man who sweeps the floor in the Tianqing Sect's scripture library. At this moment, he still held that old worn bamboo broom in his hand. His turbid eyes swept across everyone present before finally landing on Chen Ji, slightly narrowing.

dialogue.content: "The Tianqing Sect is a place of secluded cultivation; how can it tolerate outsiders making a commotion?" Mo Xiansheng's voice was not loud, yet it rang like a great bell, making everyone's eardrums ache. "If the Liu Family has family matters, discuss them at the Sect Affairs Hall another day. Today's matter ends here. Liu Family Elder, what do you say?"

text.content: The Liu Family Elder's face shifted continuously, cold sweat drenching his forehead. Although Mo Xiansheng was dressed as a menial servant, how could he not know this 'sweeping old man's' status in the Tianqing Sect—that was someone even the Sect Master would treat with courtesy. He gritted his teeth and forced a smile: "Since Mo Xiansheng has spoken, I will graciously give face today and take my leave for now." With that, he flicked his sleeve and led the Liu Family crowd to retreat in dejection.

Mo Xiansheng withdrew his gaze and lightly glanced at Chen Ji. That look seemed profound, as if saying: "Brat, you certainly kept your composure today." Chen Ji's heart tightened. He bowed respectfully and dared not speak further. Mo Xiansheng didn't linger either. He turned and left, the bamboo broom making rustling sounds on the ground as he quickly disappeared into the distance. The surrounding spectators looked at each other in bewilderment; today's events were truly too twists and turns—they needed time to slowly digest.

The crowd gradually dispersed. Chen Ji stood alone in place, looking down at the Turtle Shell Fragment in his arms. The azure light had completely vanished. The shell's surface remained mottled and ancient, as if everything just now had merely been an illusion for everyone. He gently stroked the fragment, and a barely perceptible smile slowly curved at the corner of his mouth. Was the Tianji Record's strange movement just now a warning, or guidance? Before he could think further, a cold gaze suddenly fell upon his back like something tangible.

dialogue.content: "Chen Ji." A cold female voice sounded nearby. Chen Ji turned to see Su Qingyao standing in the empty space left after the crowd dispersed, her green robes rippling in the wind, a few strands of hair lifted by the breeze, her face still cold as frost. Her gaze lingered on Chen Ji for a moment, seemingly examining, seemingly confirming something. After a while, she slightly nodded and lightly parted her thin lips, uttering only two words: "Not bad."

text.content: Chen Ji was slightly stunned. These two words, coming from Su Qingyao's mouth, carried immense weight. One had to know that this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow of the Tianqing Sect had always looked down on everyone; the number of people who could catch her eye could be counted on one hand. Yet now, in front of everyone, she gave this waste a rating of 'not bad'? Before Chen Ji could respond, Su Qingyao had already turned and left, her back cold as moonlight.

But Chen Ji saw clearly—just as Su Qingyao turned, there was an extremely faint curve at the corner of her mouth, vanishing in an instant. His heart stirred; she had indeed noticed. Not just the counterattack just now, but also... the moment the Turtle Shell Fragment glowed. She was the only person who hadn't shown a surprised expression, as if she had long known that fragment was no ordinary object. Chen Ji took a deep breath, tucked the Turtle Shell Fragment into his chest, and raised his eyes to the horizon. The situation was more complicated than he had anticipated, but at least today, he won.

choice.prompt: The crowd had dispersed; Su Qingyao's back was fading into the distance. Chen Ji stood alone, the residual warmth of the Turtle Shell Fragment still in his chest. At this moment, he could choose his next move.

choices.description: Proactively approach this Inner Disciple Senior Fellow, probe how much she actually knows, while taking the opportunity to build a closer relationship. The risk is she might gain the upper hand and directly interrogate him about the shell matter.
choices.visible_cost: Expose more flaws, arousing deeper suspicion from her
choices.visible_reward: Form an important alliance ahead of time, gaining an intelligence channel within the Inner Sect
choices.risk_hint: Su Qingyao is extremely sharp; this might backfire

dialogue.content: "Senior Sister Su, please wait." Chen Ji快步上前, clasped his hands in a bow, "Regarding the matter just now, thank you, Senior Sister, for speaking out for justice."

Su Qingyao's脚步一顿, she turned to look back, her gaze sharp as an icy blade sweeping across Chen Ji's face. "Before today, there was no connection between us. How could there be speaking out for justice?" Her tone was cold, but she didn't leave.

choices.description: Stay put and let Su Qingyao come find him. Since she's already suspicious, she'll eventually be unable to contain herself—a prey that comes to you voluntarily doesn't need to be rushed.
choices.visible_cost: Miss the opportunity to be alone with her; might be truly seen as just a waste
choices.visible_reward: Maintain an air of mystery, letting her actively enter the game; preserve trump cards without revealing them
choices.risk_hint: If she loses interest, future contact will be even harder

dialogue.content: Chen Ji clasped his hands in a bow, his posture respectful, and said: "Senior Sister travels slowly; when there's an opportunity another day, I will again seek guidance from Senior Sister." His voice was neither loud nor soft, perfectly conveying a hint of reverence and distance, as if he were truly just a small figure who stumbled upon great luck, expressing gratitude to the unattainable Inner Disciple Senior Fellow.

text.content: The crowd had dispersed; twilight deepened. Chen Ji walked alone back to the firewood hut where the servants lived, his footsteps unhurried. Pushing open the door and entering, the room was dim and cramped, the air filled with the mingled scent of old wood and herbs. He sat on the simple wooden bed, took out the Turtle Shell Fragment from his chest, and examined it carefully under the last sliver of daylight filtering through the window. The patterns on the fragment's surface seemed even more distinct than yesterday, faint lines outlining some kind of mysterious diagram. Why had it suddenly awakened just now, in front of everyone?

Just at this moment, a row of tiny characters, as if written in blood with an archaic style, suddenly appeared on the fragment's surface: "Volume One Nears Its End; the Lock and Key Have Been Moved." Chen Ji's pupils slightly contracted. Heavenly Fate Lock and Key—that was Chen Nian's nickname. She had been taken away by the Holy Sect many years ago with no news; she was Chen Ji's deepest obsession and his only weakness in this world. What did this line of text on the Tianji Record Fragment mean? A warning, or guidance?

Chen Ji gripped the fragment in his palm, his knuckles white from force. His expression remained calm, yet deep within those fathomless eyes, flames were quietly burning. Today's humiliation from the Liu Family, he remembered; Su Qingyao's two nods, he remembered; Mo Xiansheng's meaningful glance, he remembered even more clearly, carving every detail into his heart. These people, these events, these variables—one day, each would find their place in the chess game he was laying out. He slowly closed his eyes, a smile barely perceptible curling at the corner of his mouth.

Night completely enveloped the Tianqing Sect. Inside the firewood hut, all was darkness. Chen Ji did not light a lamp, merely sitting quietly in the darkness, listening to the low chirping of night insects outside the window. His breathing was steady as ever, as if all the conflicts and waves just now had nothing to do with him. But if someone were nearby, they would discover that the Turtle Shell Fragment in Chen Ji's palm was emitting a faint azure glow in the night—weak, yet stubborn, like dragon scales lying dormant at the bottom of an abyss, waiting only for when the wind rises and clouds surge, to break through the water,震慑天下.
